# Wattever

> LLM endpoint throughput and deterministic task-accuracy benchmarking with optional local telemetry, public model configuration identities and shareable audit JSON. The Python helper supports managed LM Studio or externally managed streaming Chat Completions. Hosted browser timing uses a separate protocol; its capability catalog is read-only.

## Core docs

- [Overview](README.md): quick start and project scope.
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): full guide map.
- [Browser mode](docs/browser.md): hosted connection, measurement and storage limits.
- [Sharing results](docs/sharing-results.md): shared catalog, contributions and continuing helper sessions.
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): provider choice, automatic endpoint identity, connection, manual model IDs and first run.
- [Measurements](docs/measurements.md): client/provider timings, cache provenance, power boundaries, hardware and compute claims.
- [RTX 5060 Ti storage comparison](docs/5060-ti-storage-comparison.md): recorded Strata SATA/NVMe timings, repeats, speedups and hardware conditions.
- [RTX 5070 Ti hardware and storage follow-up](docs/5070-ti-hardware-follow-up.md): 144 completed paired storage observations, prefill/decode aggregates, actual drafting evidence, transfer measurements and the pending active-channel report.
- [PNY versus ASUS Prime RTX 5070 Ti](docs/pny-5070-ti-comparison.md): 156 primary PNY cases with one repeat, GPU power and throughput comparisons with ASUS and RTX 5060 Ti; incomplete storage data retained separately.
- [i7-5820K versus i7-5960X](docs/5960x-cpu-comparison.md): same PNY RTX 5070 Ti, 156 matched CPU cases across the 13 established models, measured transfer/compute probes and uncertainty limits.
- [PNY RTX 5070 Ti plus ASUS RTX 5060 Ti](docs/5070-plus-5060-comparison.md): matched and supplemental LM Studio measurements, per-card/combined energy, transfer/compute probes, connection diagnostics and Strata coverage status.
- [Multi-GPU communication and placement study](docs/dual-gpu-communication-and-placement.md): communication paths, transfer measurements, GPU execution strategies, profiling evidence and diagnostic protocol boundaries.
- [Two RTX 5070 Ti cards](docs/two-5070-ti-comparison.md): 180 normal cases, matched single/mixed-card throughput and energy, native drafting and per-card temperatures.
- [Two RTX 5070 Ti placement strategies](docs/two-5070-ti-placement.md): measured communication paths, standalone prefill/decode, independent instances, energy and profiling limits.
- [Capability evaluation](docs/capabilities.md): visual score/coverage dashboard, question-by-repeat evidence explorer, pinned Core/GSM8K/ARC suites and paired-comparison limits.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): components and boundaries.
- [API](docs/api.md): automatic naming/opaque route identity, private registry boundaries, environment-based authentication, local routes and managed-only extensions.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): common questions and limits.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): diagnosis and fixes.
